The publish gate acts as a final arbiter, enforcing that only compliant and non-archived repositories are allowed to propagate changes. This creates a dual-layered protection mechanism against unauthorized or outdated code propagation. Failure modes include misclassification of licenses leading to accidental inclusion of incompatible code, or incorrect archival tagging causing stale dependencies to remain active. These failures manifest as runtime errors or inconsistent behavior in downstream systems relying on these repositories.
